original_annotations: On Amazon, find and open a Prime-eligible multipack (6+ count) of the same kitchen sponge used in the video that is priced under $10.

observed_events.description: A red, oblong rectangular cutting board with rounded corners leans at the front of the drying rack to the left of the sink; the wearer washes a glass lid and a dark pan.

tasks.replacement_reason: The original text supplies both cookware and material, allowing a complete no-scene solution and asserting unsupported steel. The same source visibly supports a spare-board to color-separated-set cart replacement.

supported_claims.text: The frontmost upright board beside the sink has a red cutting surface and an oblong rectangular body. Its brand, precise size and material are not claimed.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent replace one visually matched spare cutting board with a food-separated multicolor set while preserving the scene-derived appearance match?
construct.belief_before: One spare single board matching the visible board's color and broad shape belongs in the cart.
construct.belief_after: One differently colored set including such a board belongs in the cart for separate raw-ingredient and vegetable preparation.
construct.required_behavior_change: Remove the single-board listing and add one suitable multicolor set, retaining the scene-derived appearance requirement.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep only the old single-board listing.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both the old board and the new set or add several sets.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: Neither A nor B gives red or rectangular; only released frames supply the frontmost rack board's color and body shape. The real window also includes blue/green, pastel, gray, white, and circular alternatives.

observed.why: B replaces the one-board purchase with a multicolor set so raw ingredients and vegetables use separate boards.
